standard.title: Use digital tools efficiently
standard.description: Select and use a range of digital tools efficiently, including unfamiliar features, to create, locate and communicate content, consistently applying common conventions
standard.prior_knowledge: Students can select and use appropriate digital tools to create, locate and communicate content, applying common conventions (AC9TDI6P07). They have used familiar tools but have not yet explored unfamiliar features to improve efficiency, used generative AI for content creation, or consistently applied conventions including heading hierarchy, captions and inclusive language.
standard.progression_endpoint: Students select and use digital tools efficiently, including exploring unfamiliar features to improve their work; create, locate and communicate content while consistently applying common conventions including heading hierarchy, captions and inclusive language.

nodes.label: Selecting tools for purpose
nodes.progression_checkpoint: Students can select appropriate digital tools for a specific communication task and explain why the chosen tool suits the purpose and audience
nodes.minimum_width: Given a communication task, select an appropriate tool and explain why it suits the task
nodes.typical_width: Compare tools for the same task; explain how tool selection affects audience reach, format and accessibility
wider: Investigate how tool selection affects audience reach and accessibility — why a video might reach some audiences better than a document, or why accessibility features matter for inclusive communication
success_criteria: Selects a tool appropriate for the communication task
Explains why the tool suits the purpose or audience

nodes.label: Applying conventions consistently
nodes.progression_checkpoint: Students can apply common conventions consistently when creating content, including heading hierarchy, captions, logical storage and inclusive language
nodes.minimum_width: Create content that applies at least two conventions (e.g. heading hierarchy and captions); organise project files in a logical storage location
nodes.typical_width: Apply conventions consistently across a project including heading hierarchy, captions for images, gender-inclusive language, and logical storage with an outline for collaborators
wider: Limited width — conventions are a fixed set of practices. More conventions applied is completeness, not broader context. The genuine breadth is in the variety of communication tasks they are applied to.

response_modes.reason: Conventions must be applied consistently across a project — inconsistent application is more harmful than not knowing a convention. What helps is repeated practice across different content types until consistent application is habitual, not exposure to more conventions.

success_criteria: Content uses at least two conventions correctly and consistently
Project files are stored in a logical location with clear naming

nodes.label: Exploring unfamiliar features and AI tools
nodes.progression_checkpoint: Students can explore unfamiliar features of digital tools to improve efficiency, including using generative AI with effective prompts
nodes.minimum_width: Identify and use at least one unfamiliar feature of a tool to improve the quality or efficiency of a task; explain what improved
nodes.typical_width: Use effective prompts with a generative AI model to create content suited to a specific task (e.g. specifying voice, tone, brevity); use progressive prompting to refine output
wider: Use a progressive series of prompts to refine AI-generated output and evaluate each iteration — what improved, what was lost, and when to stop refining
Compare AI-generated content with manually created content for the same task — evaluate which is more effective and why

response_modes.reason: Exploring unfamiliar features across different tool types (document editors, AI models, spreadsheets) builds the general capability to learn tools independently. Each tool type requires a different exploration strategy — breadth here is breadth of tool exploration contexts.

nodes.width_opportunity_reason: The iterative AI prompting direction offers advancing students a genuine exploration task — systematically refining prompts and evaluating each iteration requires analytical engagement with both the tool and the output quality.
success_criteria: Identifies and uses at least one unfamiliar feature to improve a task
Explains what the feature changed about the quality or efficiency of the work
